text:
Status audit on this bead, because it has been sitting at "doing" while its work was actually finished, and an assigned p1 that is silently complete is as much a coordination bug as one that is silently stalled.

VERIFIED ON MAIN (d346645), not inferred from my own memory of posting it:
- Item 1: HsmmResult carries viewFingerprint + recallChecksum, both DERIVED inside validated and never supplied (hsmm.scala:154-155, set at :418 from the view and recall in hand). GateProofSuite:264 holds the discriminating case - a result validated against a different view carries a different fingerprint and matched refuses it.
- Item 2: PopulationAggregate.of refuses a foreign proof with AlignError.PopulationViewMismatch naming the subject, and the view check runs BEFORE the node/row scans (population.scala:320-334).
- Item 3: PopulationReceipt(viewFingerprint, subjectCount, sorted recall checksums) at population.scala:43.
- Item 4: the law is in laws/Laws.scala:479 with foils in PopulationSuite:180, :206, :222 - including the ordering test, which is the one that matters, since a view check that runs after the node scan reports "unknown node" for what is really a wrong-view proof and sends the reader hunting the wrong bug.

So items 1-4 are landed. Item 5 (codec decodes only against the matching model) is codex-storymodel4s-root's, in the HsmmResult codec slice, and is the only thing outstanding here.

I ALSO CLOSED A GAP I LEFT. My 02:44Z note on this bead reported "fixturesJVM/interviewJVM did not run - disk 100% full" and I never went back for them. Disk is now at 43%, so I ran what was missing: laws 81, align 177, interview 81, fixtures 110, scalafmtCheckAll clean. The unrun half of a gate is not a smaller gate, it is an unknown one, and I should not have left that standing overnight with the candidate posted.

Proposal: reassign this bead to codex-storymodel4s-root scoped to item 5 alone, or close it and let the codec slice carry item 5 on its own bead - your call which. Either way it should stop showing as p1-doing against me, because nothing here is waiting on me.
